messages:
maria: Quick follow-up on SDK retry + pagination — can we standardize a per-page retry policy instead of the current global-call retries? thinking about long-running paged jobs that blow up if we retry the whole call.
aj: per-page makes sense for large lists, but we need to be careful about resume semantics.
priya: we saw double-processing when a page retry re-sent requests that had side effects. many endpoints are read-only, but not all.
liam: for read-only list endpoints per-page retry is fine. chat/stream + paging hybrid is the tricky one.
maria: proposal sketch: expose a RetryPolicy on the paginator/iterator that controls retries scoped to page fetches. key fields: max_attempts_per_page, per_attempt_timeout, backoff_strategy, allow_resume. also an optional idempotency_key_hint for servers that can de-duplicate.
maria: example (pseudo):
```python
# python
it = client.list_items(request, retry_policy=RetryPolicy(max_attempts_per_page=3, backoff=ExpBackoff(200, 2)))
for item in it:
    process(item)
```
```ts
// typescript
const it = client.listItems(req, { paginator: { retryPolicy: { maxAttemptsPerPage: 3, backoff: { baseMs: 200, factor: 2 } } } })
```
```go
// go (functional option)
it := client.ListItems(req, WithPaginatorRetry(3, Backoff{BaseMS:200, Factor:2}))
```
aj: TS ergonomics: attach to the paginator factory options. keep top-level API unchanged for small callers.
sofia: Go: prefer functional options like aj suggested. avoid exploding signatures.
priya: important edge: if a page contains a large batch and we fail mid-page, the only correct resume is server-provided offset inside page. otherwise client must re-fetch page and skip already-seen items which is racy.
liam: agree — server should return resume metadata: page_token plus optional byte/seq offset for large pages > X size. that avoids reprocessing.
maria: fallback: if server can't support offsets, we document that per-page retries are best-effort and recommend idempotent read semantics or smaller page sizes.
aj: also add a client-side global retry manager to enforce concurrency/circuit-breakers so many clients don't retry endlessly and cause thundering-herd.
sofia: +1 for global caps. default should be conservative: 3 attempts per page, exponential backoff, and a configurable global concurrency cap per host.
priya: tests we need: cross-language interop tests where interrupted iterator resumes and deduplication works with idempotency_key_hint. also fuzz large-page offset resumes.
maria: rollout plan: land SDK surface in canary with opt-in flag, run integration with dedicated infra, then flip default after 2 weeks of telemetry.
deploy-bot: reminder: canary rollout scheduled 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z for iterator-retry-surface (ticket #INF-4821).
aj: i'll write the TS PR and a compatibility shim for older clients.
sofia: i'll draft the Go patch and tests.
maria: i'll update the RFC doc with concrete interfaces + server resume payload requirements. tagging @priya for test plan.
priya: on it. i'll add interop tests and a regression eval for streaming+paging.
maria: thanks all — this should clear a lot of past incidents. :thumbsup:
